doc_summary: `native_mouse_button_pre(button, pressed, modifiers, canceled)` sees real button events on any screen, before normal dispatch. Button and modifiers use the screen hooks' GLFW encoding. Physical button bookkeeping already ran. Cancellation skips normal dispatch and Post. Accepted events call `native_mouse_button_post(button, pressed, modifiers)` after dispatch, including screen handlers' early returns. Synthetic pad/focus clicks skip both hooks. Existing screen-specific hooks and native_key notifications remain. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mouse_button_events@.
